build.name: cmake + make libleveldb (tests/benchmarks off: googletest is a submodule absent from the release tarball)
build.cmd: mkdir -p $BODY/build/ldb && cd $BODY/build/ldb && cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DLEVELDB_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DLEVELDB_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF $BODY/upstream/tree/leveldb-1.23 >/dev/null && make -s leveldb 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; test -f libleveldb.a && echo built

runs.name: CRASH: write 500 more (acknowledged, unsynced) and _exit() without closing -- they live only in the .log
reopen: RecoverLogFile replays the log (the recovery property: 2500 present)

notes: Oracle: acknowledged writes that never reached a table survive a process crash via write-ahead-log replay on open. DEVIATION: upstream unit tests not built (googletest submodule not in the tarball).
